# synology_configuration_backup (Data Source)

Read-only automatic DSM configuration-backup policy and status. No backup, restore, enable or encryption-key operation is performed. The DSM setter can return new recovery-key material; mutations remain outside the provider until a complete key-delivery and recovery contract is established. Configuration backup does not back up shared-folder data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "synology_configuration_backup" "nas" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Observed automatic configuration-backup policy.
- `encryption_method` (String) Observed encryption method. Passwords and recovery keys never enter state.
- `failure_reason_code` (Number) Last DSM failure reason code.
- `id` (String) Stable discovery identity: configuration_backup.
- `last_check_time` (String) Last check time returned by DSM.
- `last_status` (String) Last backup result. An enabled policy does not prove a successful backup.
- `last_success_time` (String) Last successful backup time returned by DSM.
